sources.title: Priyamehta/swin-t-experiment · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Swin T for Retrieval. The large configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.
